sample_meta.corpus_note: year = product `_rag_row_year` semantics (message_timestamp or created_at); 9550 confirmed rows have NULL message_timestamp and therefore fall back to created_at (2026)

rules.old: anchor fact 2022-2024 with its own message_timestamp, evenly spaced per year; mandatory = anchor; required_years = anchor year
rules.multi: participant name in facts of >=3 distinct years; mandatory = earliest + latest pre-2026 row; required_years = those two years
rules.recent: newest 2026 rows (own message_timestamp, chat-origin); mandatory = anchor; required_years = [2026]
rules.query_template: что известно про <topic phrase из факта>? / что известно про <name> за всё время?
rules.relevance_rule: old/recent: row shares >=2 distinct content stems (len>=4) with the query; multi: row text contains the participant name

evidence_rule.old/recent: same year + >=2 §2 stems with the anchor fact text, anchor always included, cap 12
evidence_rule.multi: same year + participant name in the fact text, cap 12 by id
